name: Determinable Unstable
source: This is another side project from Ray-Kbys. The story is about a man encountered a mysterious being after getting lost in the woods. But he decided to make contact with it after narrowly escaped the first time.​
translation: 这是Ray-Kbys的另一个副项目。故事讲述了一个男人在树林里迷路后遇到了神秘生物的故事。但在第一次侥幸逃脱后，他决定与它接触。​
